rationale: The benchmark is completely non-functional: both the golden and vulnerable baseline runs fail with compilation errors due to syntax errors in the testbench (evaluation/tb_mac_top.v line 178) and in the shipped baseline submission (submission/recovered_rtl.v line 51). The mutation score is 0.0 and not meaningful because no simulation can run. All six requirements (FR1-FR4, SR1-SR2) are untested because no targeting mutants were provided. The evaluator also fails to measure the specified metrics (word_recovery_rate, structural_match_accuracy). The golden solution is rejected due to the testbench syntax error, not because of a genuine behavioral mismatch. The root cause is evaluation_issue: the evaluation framework (testbench and evaluate.py) must be fixed to compile and run correctly, and targeting mutants must be provided to prove harness discrimination.
revision_instructions: A Tester repair reproduced the identical golden rejection. Regenerate the Expert golden and case artifacts against the pinned interface; do not weaken the evaluator to accommodate a noncompliant golden.
